description:
Add performance measurement and observability for query plan capture to
understand and control the overhead introduced by plan capture. Implement
sampling and external storage options to minimize impact on benchmark results.

**Problems Addressed**:
- No measurement of plan capture overhead (could be 5-20% of query time)
- Cannot sample captures (all-or-nothing with --capture-plans)
- Plans embedded in JSON inflate result files unbounded
- No visibility into which queries have expensive EXPLAIN operations
